scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @fuwa-hitsuji/shared && npm run build --workspace @fuwa-hitsuji/game-core && npm run build --workspace @fuwa-hitsuji/web && npm run build --workspace @fuwa-hitsuji/server
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @fuwa-hitsuji/shared && npm run build --workspace @fuwa-hitsuji/game-core && npm run test --workspace @fuwa-hitsuji/game-core && npm run test --workspace @fuwa-hitsuji/web && npm run test --workspace @fuwa-hitsuji/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @fuwa-hitsuji/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @fuwa-hitsuji/shared && npm run build --workspace @fuwa-hitsuji/game-core && npm run typecheck --workspace @fuwa-hitsuji/game-core && npx tsc -p tsconfig.web.typecheck.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @fuwa-hitsuji/server
